title: ABAP Transport of Copies
tagline: Create, release and import Transports of Copies with one click.
summary: A fork of Kaszub09/abapToC with an abap2UI5 front end. It brings the transaction ZTOC and the app zcl_zabap_toc_ui5, from which a developer creates, releases and imports Transports of Copies from one list, one click per transport or as a mass action on all selected ones. The Transport of Copies logic is the upstream one; changes to it belong upstream first.
features: Create, release and import a Transport of Copies with one click
Mass action on all selected ToCs
Three kinds of ToC descriptions: request number, request description or custom
Retries the import while the ToC is not yet visible in the target system
Support for sub transports, transport groups and choosing a different target system
Transaction ZTOC in SAP GUI and an abap2UI5 app in the browser
requirements: abap2UI5 for the browser front end

notes: Install with abapGit: abap2UI5 first, then this repository (branch main)
Import or transport the project to the target system
In SM59 create a connection for each possible transport target with exactly the same name as the target (for example ZZZ.999 for system ZZZ client 999, or ZZZ without client)
Optional: set the development system as trusted in SMT1 at the target system and use Trust Relationship with Current User to avoid logging in on every import
Start with transaction ZTOC in SAP GUI or ?app_start=zcl_zabap_toc_ui5 in the browser
